meta.beschrijving: Generate a colour palette in your browser, just like in the Colair app. Pick a harmony, adjust, and take it with you. Free, no account.

palet.hoger: Move this color up one place (⌥↑)
palet.lager: Move this color down one place (⌥↓)
palet.vol: A palette has at most 8 colours
palet.minimaal: A palette has at least 2 colours

kleur.uitleg: A colour you choose yourself is locked: Generate leaves it.

analogous.uitleg: Neighbours on the wheel: calm and coherent.

complementary.uitleg: Opposites on the wheel: maximum contrast.

splitComplementary.uitleg: A colour plus the neighbours of its opposite.

triad.uitleg: Three colours at equal distance: lively.

tetrad.uitleg: Two pairs of opposites: rich and varied.

square.uitleg: Four colours at 90°: playful and full.

monochrome.uitleg: One hue in light and dark.

analogousAccent.uitleg: Calm neighbours with one contrasting accent.

exporteer.kaartUitleg: Image with name, logo and hex codes

begin.label: Start from
begin.zoekt: Colair finds the colours that shape the picture.

uitAfbeelding.uitleg: Colours are chosen by how often they appear and how different they are. Your photo stays on your device.
